articles.title: GST Council meeting today: No rate changes likely, faster refunds | 10 key expections, reforms on table

articles.title: STT: What began in lieu of capital gains tax relief survives on flimsy grounds—time to axe it?
articles.description: The tax was a tracker rather than a revenue source. But not only has capital gains tax come right back since then, STT has turned into a coffer filler and market intervention tool. That’s not what it was meant to be. Why not get rid of it?
